title: Mosebi wa Gauta mo Sekakeng
intro: Akanya fela kampa e kgolo ya sekaka mo motsotsong wa go leta le go sa tlhomamisege. Moeteledipele yo mogolo o tsamaile go ya kopanong le Bomodimo, a tlogela morafe o o tlhoafetseng sengwe se se bonalang se o ka se tshwarelang. Mo kgaolong eo e e sa iketlang, setshwantsho se se tlhotlheletsang se tlhagelela ka ditsholofetso tse di phatsimang le popo e e botlhale e e lebegang e tshela.
clues: Ke ne ke le mongwe wa ba ba neng ba tswa kwa Egepeto le Musa, ke bona lewatle le kgaogana gore re kgone go tshaba.
Ke ne ka lebelela fa moeteledipele wa rona a ne a ya kwa thabeng masigo a le masome a mane go ya go amogela kaelo.
Ke ne ka phutha mekgabiso mo bathong mme ka e bopa ka diatla tsa me.
Ke ne ka bopa namane e e neng e ntsha modumo wa go lela, mme ka bitsa batho kwa go yone.
Ke ne ka tsaya lerole le le tletseng seatla mo tseleng ya morongwa mme ka le latlhela mo go se ke neng ke se dirile.
Ke ne ka lebana le Musa mme ka atlholwa go re ‘o se ka wa nkgoma’ mme ka nna ke kgaogane, ka kopano e e solofeditsweng ya katlholo.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
